mutants.description: Strike blink stops once the rail is back in regulation, as if power-good meant the strikes were resolved, instead of lasting until clean_run_target clears them
mutants.reason: During the clean-run window after a hiccup (S_RUN, pgood high, strike_level non-zero, no latch), Red_LED1 goes dark when it should keep blinking until the strikes clear.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is held off while strikes are outstanding, as if regulation did not count until the board had earned its clear
mutants.reason: While recovering in S_RUN with pgood high and strike_level non-zero, pgood_LED stays low instead of following the comparator.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is shown only while the converter is soft-starting or running, so the case UVLO most often produces - a converter held off in S_OFF - is left dark
mutants.reason: With uvlo_state high while the supervisor is in S_OFF (ss_active and run_active both low), Red_LED3 stays low instead of lighting.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is also lit by loss of output power-good, confusing input undervoltage with an output rail out of regulation
mutants.reason: Whenever pgood is low with uvlo_state low (S_OFF, soft-start, hiccup), Red_LED3 lights although there is no input undervoltage.

mutants.description: Running indication treats outstanding strikes as an active state, so Green stays lit through the hiccup off-time instead of going dark in S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: In S_HICCUP with strike_level non-zero and no OTP/UVLO/latch live, Green_LED is lit although the converter is not switching.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator blinks with the strike timebase instead of being lit solid, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: While otp_state is held high, Red_LED2 goes low during every low half of the blink square wave instead of staying solid.

mutants.description: The CPLD's own trip into the latch is shown blinking until the SCR readback confirms it, instead of solid from the moment latch_assert rises
mutants.reason: In the clocks where latch_assert is high but the debounced latch_state has not yet risen, Red_LED1 follows blink instead of being driven solid high.
